<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that break ketones and C‑C triple bonds (the groups lost in the forward cycloaddition), form a C‑C single bond, and break a C‑O single bond. This matches the described transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
